name: grampus
description: Coding-agent pipeline on Orca orchestration: spec, build, verify, review, repair, measured

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs fast
scripts.test:all: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs all
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.check:full: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:all
